import Mathlib

structure DFSGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def DFSGraph.well_formed (g : DFSGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def DFSGraph.size (g : DFSGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def DFSGraph.has_edge (g : DFSGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def DFSGraph.is_path (g : DFSGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def DFSGraph.reachable (g : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dfs_check_reachability_precond (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧ start < graph.size ∧ target < graph.size
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- `reachIn g k u t` is true iff there is a path from `u` to `t` using at most
    `k` edges (i.e. at most `k+1` nodes). -/
def reachIn (g : DFSGraph) : Nat → Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, u, t => u == t
  | k + 1, u, t => (u == t) || (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.any (fun v => reachIn g k v t)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def dfs_check_reachability (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h_precond : dfs_check_reachability_precond graph start target) : Bool :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  reachIn graph graph.size start target
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dfs_check_reachability_postcond (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat) (result : Bool)
    (_ : dfs_check_reachability_precond graph start target) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result = graph.reachable start target
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma adj_empty_of_ge (g : DFSGraph) (u : Nat) (h : ¬ u < g.adj.size) :
    g.adj.getD u #[] = #[] := by
  simp [Array.getD, h]

lemma getLast?_cons_ne_nil {α : Type*} (a : α) (l : List α) (h : l ≠ []) :
    (a :: l).getLast? = l.getLast? := by
  cases l with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl h
  | cons b bs => simp

lemma getLast?_append_cons {α : Type*} (l₁ l₂ : List α) (a : α) :
    (l₁ ++ a :: l₂).getLast? = (a :: l₂).getLast? := by
  induction l₁ with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b bs ih =>
    rw [List.cons_append]
    rw [getLast?_cons_ne_nil b (bs ++ a :: l₂) (by simp)]
    exact ih

lemma chain_of_path (g : DFSGraph) : ∀ (p : List Nat),
    (∀ i, i + 1 < p.length → g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)) →
    List.IsChain g.has_edge p := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro _; simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    cases l with
    | nil => intro _; simp
    | cons b l' =>
      intro h
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons]
      refine ⟨by simpa using h 0 (by simp), ?_⟩
      refine ih (fun i hi => ?_)
      have := h (i + 1) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega)
      simpa using this

lemma path_of_chain (g : DFSGraph) : ∀ (p : List Nat), List.IsChain g.has_edge p →
    ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length → g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro _ i hi; simp at hi
  | cons a l ih =>
    cases l with
    | nil => intro _ i hi; simp at hi
    | cons b l' =>
      intro h i hi
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at h
      cases i with
      | zero => simpa using h.1
      | succ j =>
        have := ih h.2 j (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega)
        simpa using this

lemma is_path_iff (g : DFSGraph) (p : List Nat) :
    g.is_path p ↔ p ≠ [] ∧ List.IsChain g.has_edge p := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hlen, hedge⟩
    refine ⟨fun h => by simp [h] at hlen, chain_of_path g p hedge⟩
  · rintro ⟨hne, hc⟩
    refine ⟨?_, path_of_chain g p hc⟩
    cases p with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
    | cons a l => simp

lemma chain_mem_lt (g : DFSGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (x : Nat), List.IsChain g.has_edge p → p.head? = some x →
      x < g.adj.size → ∀ y ∈ p, y < g.adj.size := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro x _ hh _ y hy; simp at hy
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro x hc hh hx y hy
    rw [List.head?_cons, Option.some_inj] at hh
    subst hh
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with rfl | hy'
    · exact hx
    · cases l with
      | nil => simp at hy'
      | cons b l' =>
        rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hc
        have hb : b < g.adj.size := hwf _ hc.1.1 b hc.1.2
        exact ih b hc.2 rfl hb y hy'

lemma not_nodup_decomp {α : Type*} :
    ∀ (p : List α), ¬ p.Nodup → ∃ a l₁ l₂ l₃, p = l₁ ++ a :: (l₂ ++ a :: l₃) := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro h; simp at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro h
    rw [List.nodup_cons] at h
    by_cases hx : x ∈ xs
    · obtain ⟨l₂, l₃, rfl⟩ := List.append_of_mem hx
      exact ⟨x, [], l₂, l₃, by simp⟩
    · have hnd : ¬ xs.Nodup := by tauto
      obtain ⟨a, l₁, l₂, l₃, rfl⟩ := ih hnd
      exact ⟨a, x :: l₁, l₂, l₃, by simp⟩

lemma exists_nodup_chain {α : Type*} (R : α → α → Prop) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : List α), p.length ≤ n → p ≠ [] → List.IsChain R p →
      ∃ q : List α, q ≠ [] ∧ List.IsChain R q ∧ q.head? = p.head? ∧
        q.getLast? = p.getLast? ∧ q.Nodup ∧ ∀ y ∈ q, y ∈ p := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro p hlen hne _
    exact absurd (List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (Nat.le_zero.mp hlen)) hne
  | succ n ih =>
    intro p hlen hne hc
    by_cases hnd : p.Nodup
    · exact ⟨p, hne, hc, rfl, rfl, hnd, fun y hy => hy⟩
    · obtain ⟨a, l₁, l₂, l₃, rfl⟩ := not_nodup_decomp p hnd
      have hcA := List.isChain_append.mp hc
      have hB : List.IsChain R ((a :: l₂) ++ (a :: l₃)) := by
        rw [List.cons_append]; exact hcA.2.1
      have hB2 := List.isChain_append.mp hB
      have hc' : List.IsChain R (l₁ ++ a :: l₃) := by
        rw [List.isChain_append]
        refine ⟨hcA.1, hB2.2.1, ?_⟩
        intro x hx y hy
        exact hcA.2.2 x hx y (by simpa using hy)
      have hlen' : (l₁ ++ a :: l₃).length ≤ n := by
        simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons] at hlen ⊢
        omega
      have hne' : (l₁ ++ a :: l₃) ≠ [] := by simp
      obtain ⟨q, hq0, hqc, hqh, hql, hqn, hqm⟩ := ih _ hlen' hne' hc'
      refine ⟨q, hq0, hqc, ?_, ?_, hqn, ?_⟩
      · rw [hqh]
        cases l₁ with
        | nil => simp
        | cons b bs => simp
      · rw [hql, getLast?_append_cons, getLast?_append_cons, ← List.cons_append,
          getLast?_append_cons]
      · intro y hy
        have hmem := hqm y hy
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at hmem ⊢
        tauto

lemma nodup_length_le (q : List Nat) (n : Nat) (h : ∀ y ∈ q, y < n) (hq : q.Nodup) :
    q.length ≤ n := by
  have h1 : q.toFinset ⊆ Finset.range n := by
    intro x hx
    rw [List.mem_toFinset] at hx
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    exact h x hx
  have h2 := Finset.card_le_card h1
  rwa [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hq, Finset.card_range] at h2

lemma reachIn_sound (g : DFSGraph) : ∀ (k u t : Nat), reachIn g k u t = true →
    ∃ p : List Nat, p ≠ [] ∧ List.IsChain g.has_edge p ∧ p.head? = some u ∧
      p.getLast? = some t := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro u t h
    simp only [reachIn, beq_iff_eq] at h
    subst h
    exact ⟨[u], by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro u t h
    simp only [reachIn, Bool.or_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, List.any_eq_true] at h
    rcases h with h | ⟨v, hv, hr⟩
    · subst h
      exact ⟨[u], by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
    · obtain ⟨q, hq0, hqc, hqh, hql⟩ := ih v t hr
      have hu : u < g.adj.size := by
        by_contra hcon
        rw [adj_empty_of_ge g u hcon] at hv
        simp at hv
      have he : g.has_edge u v := ⟨hu, by rw [Array.mem_def]; exact hv⟩
      cases q with
      | nil => exact absurd rfl hq0
      | cons b q' =>
        rw [List.head?_cons, Option.some_inj] at hqh
        subst hqh
        refine ⟨u :: b :: q', by simp, ?_, by simp, ?_⟩
        · rw [List.isChain_cons_cons]
          exact ⟨he, hqc⟩
        · rw [getLast?_cons_ne_nil u (b :: q') (by simp)]
          exact hql

lemma reachIn_complete (g : DFSGraph) : ∀ (k : Nat) (p : List Nat) (u t : Nat),
    p.length ≤ k + 1 → List.IsChain g.has_edge p → p.head? = some u → p.getLast? = some t →
    reachIn g k u t = true := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro p u t hlen hc hh hl
    cases p with
    | nil => simp at hh
    | cons a l =>
      rw [List.head?_cons, Option.some_inj] at hh
      subst hh
      have hnil : l = [] := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen
        exact List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by omega)
      subst hnil
      simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some_inj] at hl
      subst hl
      simp [reachIn]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro p u t hlen hc hh hl
    cases p with
    | nil => simp at hh
    | cons a l =>
      rw [List.head?_cons, Option.some_inj] at hh
      subst hh
      cases l with
      | nil =>
        simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some_inj] at hl
        subst hl
        simp [reachIn]
      | cons b l' =>
        rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hc
        have hlen' : (b :: l').length ≤ k + 1 := by
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen ⊢
          omega
        have hl' : (b :: l').getLast? = some t := by
          rwa [getLast?_cons_ne_nil _ (b :: l') (by simp)] at hl
        have hrec : reachIn g k b t = true := ih (b :: l') b t hlen' hc.2 rfl hl'
        simp only [reachIn, Bool.or_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, List.any_eq_true]
        right
        exact ⟨b, by rw [← Array.mem_def]; exact hc.1.2, hrec⟩
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem dfs_check_reachability_postcond_satisfied (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h_precond : dfs_check_reachability_precond graph start target) :
    dfs_check_reachability_postcond graph start target
      (dfs_check_reachability graph start target h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hwf, hs, ht⟩ := h_precond
  simp only [dfs_check_reachability_postcond, dfs_check_reachability]
  rw [eq_iff_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨p, hp0, hpc, hph, hpl⟩ := reachIn_sound graph _ _ _ h
    exact ⟨p, (is_path_iff graph p).mpr ⟨hp0, hpc⟩, hph, hpl⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hip, hph, hpl⟩
    obtain ⟨hp0, hpc⟩ := (is_path_iff graph p).mp hip
    obtain ⟨q, hq0, hqc, hqh, hql, hqn, hqm⟩ :=
      exists_nodup_chain graph.has_edge p.length p le_rfl hp0 hpc
    have hmem : ∀ y ∈ p, y < graph.adj.size := chain_mem_lt graph hwf p start hpc hph hs
    have hlen : q.length ≤ graph.adj.size :=
      nodup_length_le q _ (fun y hy => hmem y (hqm y hy)) hqn
    have hsz : graph.size = graph.adj.size := rfl
    exact reachIn_complete graph graph.size q start target (by rw [hsz]; omega) hqc
      (hqh.trans hph) (hql.trans hpl)
  -- !benchmark @end proof

## Approach

Rather than an imperative stack-based DFS (whose termination and visited-set invariant are painful), I used a **bounded reachability** formulation that is extensionally the same search but structurally recursive:

```lean
def reachIn (g : DFSGraph) : Nat → Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0,     u, t => u == t
  | k + 1, u, t => (u == t) || (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.any (fun v => reachIn g k v t)
```

`dfs_check_reachability = reachIn graph graph.size start target`. Recursion is on the fuel `k`, so **termination** is free even with cycles.

The three obligations from the task:

1. **Soundness** (`reachIn_sound`): induction on `k` constructs an explicit witness path — `[u]` in the base/equal case, `u :: q` when a neighbour `v` succeeds. The `u < adj.size` side condition comes from the fact that `Array.getD` returns `#[]` out of bounds, so a successful `any` forces the index to be in range (`adj_empty_of_ge`).

2. **Completeness** (`reachIn_complete` + the cycle-removal chain): induction on `k` shows any path with `≤ k+1` nodes is found. To close the gap for arbitrary (possibly long, cyclic) paths, this replaces the visited-set invariant:
   - `not_nodup_decomp`: a non-`Nodup` list splits as `l₁ ++ a :: (l₂ ++ a :: l₃)`.
   - `exists_nodup_chain`: strong induction on length — splice out the cycle to get `l₁ ++ a :: l₃`, which is still a chain (via `List.isChain_append`) with the same head and last, and is strictly shorter. Yields a `Nodup` path with the same endpoints, all of whose nodes come from the original.
   - `chain_mem_lt` (using `well_formed` and `start < size`) puts every node of the path in `[0, size)`, so `nodup_length_le` (via `Finset.range`) bounds the `Nodup` path at `size` nodes — exactly the fuel supplied.

3. Bridging the spec's index-based `is_path` with `List.IsChain` is done by `chain_of_path` / `path_of_chain` (`is_path_iff`); the final theorem converts the `Bool = Prop` postcondition with `eq_iff_iff` and proves both directions.

Note: this Mathlib version has deprecated `List.Chain'` in favour of `List.IsChain`, and `List.chain'_iff_getElem` doesn't exist — hence the inductive proof of `is_path_iff`.
